name: Yard Security - Arm
description: Arm Yard Security now, whatever the arming mode says, until Disarm or Automatic.

name: Yard Security - Disarm
description: Disarm Yard Security now and turn off any area it has lit, until Arm or Automatic.

name: Yard Security - Automatic
description: Go back to the arming mode set on the Yard Security page.

name: Yard Security - Test Area
description: Run an area's enter action, then its exit action after the area's hold time.
